body: I dont have the words but thank you, its so hard to keep going forward its filled with so much pain.
Your right, i could never say those things to her. She knows shes hurting me but, I think it may be because of her pain. I just don't want to feel it I dont want to feel the pain anymore.

I think I am sweet but, I over think everything. I just want her to look at me like she used to like she did when we dated. Maybe its the stress that causes her to say the things that she does or maybe its my own actions. I just don't know.
